entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is VF-8675309. I want my money back, now.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your account now... I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
There's no 'fault'! I just don't want it. It's not what I thought it would be, and I want a refund. Your website says returns are easy, so let's make this easy or I'm getting a manager.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that it's a matter of preference. Let me just quickly review the return policy for your purchase.
You do that. And don't give me some runaround about it being too late. I'll post reviews everywhere about this garbage policy if you try.

Okay, I've checked the policy associated with your item. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. Since you received it 17 days ago, I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.

Yes, absolutely. The policy is clear. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you now. I'll email it to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's... that's great. I thought this was going to be a whole thing. Thanks, David.

You're very welcome, Mike. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. That's all I needed. Thank you.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
